join.zh:
您好，這裡是國泰航空桃園機場辦事處。

由於桃園機場安檢人員發現您的寄艙行李內可能含有不可寄艙的物品，須請您在場一同進行開箱檢查，並視乎結果將有關物品改為手提或棄置。因此，您的行李目前暫時留於辦理登機手續櫃位旁安檢處，尚未能安排裝載上機。如您：

⦁ 尚未進入離境禁區：請即返回 4 號辦理登機手續櫃位，與我們的職員聯絡。

⦁ 已進入離境禁區：如尚未通過離境檢查，請在辦理離境手續或通過 e-Gate 之前，向桃園機場職員說明情況，再返回確認您的行李。

⦁ 已通過離境檢查：請前往 CX{flight_number} 航班登機閘口等候國泰航空職員，我們會協助您跟進。

請注意：如您未能返回辦理登機手續櫃位旁安檢處，而上述物品經確認不符合桃園機場寄艙行李保安規定，有關物品將需要棄置，國泰航空無法代為轉交、存放或保管。

為確保您的行李能在航班起飛前完成檢查並安排裝載，請您盡快返回或聯絡國泰航空職員，多謝您的理解及配合。
join.en:
Hello, this is Cathay Pacific at Taoyuan Airport.

Airport Security found an item in your checked baggage that may not be permitted. It must be opened and inspected in your presence, and the item will then be moved to your hand baggage or disposed of. Your baggage is being held at the security area beside the check-in counter and cannot be loaded yet. If you:

⦁ Have not entered the departure area: Please return to Counter 4 immediately and contact our staff.

⦁ Are in the departure area but have not passed immigration: Please inform airport staff before using immigration or the e-Gates, then return to have your baggage checked.

⦁ Have passed immigration: Please go to the CX{flight_number} gate and wait for our staff, who will assist you.

Note: If you cannot return and the item is confirmed not to be permitted in checked baggage, it will need to be disposed of. We regret that Cathay Pacific is unable to forward, store or keep the item for you.

Please return or contact our staff as soon as possible so that your baggage can be inspected and loaded before departure. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
join.ja: 【キャセイパシフィック航空】預け手荷物のX線再検査に立会いが必要です。出国審査前は至急4番カウンターへ。保安検査後・出国審査前は係員に申し出て4番へお戻りください。出国審査後はゲート係員にお申し出ください。お越しいただけない場合、荷物が搭載できない可能性があります。
join.routing: Chinese/English -> WhatsApp; Japanese -> native SMS. Japanese has no suffix.

transit.zh:
您好：這裡是國泰航空桃園機場辦公室。

由於您的寄艙行李未能通過桃園機場的轉機X 光安全檢查。因此，您的行李目前暫時留在
轉機行李檢查處，未能安排裝載上機。

為了確保您的行李可以在航班起飛前順利完成檢查並安排裝載，麻煩您盡快返回登機閘口聯繫國泰航空職員，我們會協助您跟進。

多謝您的理解和配合
transit.en:
Hello, this is Cathay Pacific at Taoyuan Airport.

Your checked baggage did not pass the transfer X-ray security screening and is currently being held at the screening area.

Please return to the boarding gate as soon as possible and contact our staff for assistance, so we can arrange for your baggage to be loaded before departure.

Thank you for your cooperation.

transit.taipei_time: Only Transit Japanese includes current Taipei time using Asia/Taipei in 24-hour HH:mm format.
transit.ja_policy: User-approved 2026-09-23 (v1.10). Gate named in the first sentence. Many Japanese transit passengers walk toward Taiwan immigration by mistake, so the copy says not to enter immigration and to go back the way they came to the Taoyuan Airport transfer security checkpoint. No "Transfer" sign wording and no staff-fallback line (passengers who already entered Taiwan cannot make the flight). City names derived from the flight number (ja_route). Max 2 SMS (<=134).

scenario3_wrong_pickup.zh:
您好：

這是桃園機場國泰航空行李辦公室。

我們發現一件搭乘 {Arrival Flight} 抵達台北後無人領取的行李，該行李的行李牌號碼 {Bag Tag 1} 登記於您的名下。

目前另有一名旅客正在尋找一件外觀相似的行李。

請您協助確認您所領取的行李，其行李牌號碼是否為 {Bag Tag 2}？

您也可以直接拍攝您所領取行李的行李牌照片並傳送給我們確認。

為了避免耽誤您的行程，請您務必儘速聯絡我們，以確保您拿到的是正確的行李。

Email: tpe8bag@cathaypacific.com
Tel: +88627727630

謝謝您的配合。
scenario3_wrong_pickup.en:
Hello,

This is the Cathay Pacific Baggage Services Office at Taoyuan Airport.

We found one piece of unclaimed baggage from {Arrival Flight} arriving in Taipei. The baggage tag number {Bag Tag 1} is registered under your name.

Another passenger is currently looking for a similar bag.

Could you please confirm whether the baggage you collected has the baggage tag number {Bag Tag 2}?

You may also simply take a photo of the baggage tag on the bag you collected and send it to us for verification.

To avoid any disruption to your journey, please contact us as soon as possible so that we can ensure you have collected the correct baggage.

Email: tpe8bag@cathaypacific.com
Tel: +88627727630

Thank you for your cooperation.

Your flight {Disrupted Flight} is now delayed to {Delay Time}. We can arrange for you to take flight {New Flight} to {DestinationEn} (scheduled departure {Dep Time}). If you would like to take this flight, please proceed to Gate {Gate} as soon as possible and contact our staff.
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
